event: Half six, Wednesday: Bea bangs on your door; you groan, and go, legs still stiff from yesterday.
Bea makes you run slow this time; you last ten minutes before your lungs give, double yesterday.

memory.fact: On Wednesday Nala ran ten minutes along the shore at Bea's slow pace, double Tuesday's.
On Wednesday Nala ran ten minutes along the shore at Bea's slow pace, double Tuesday's.

event: Out on the mere a capped head moves through the grey water; Shiv lifts an arm and waves.
You wave back, and only go a little red; Bea notices and grins the whole way home.
Hot water again, and you stand under it until a fist on the door says it's someone else's turn.
Ten o'clock: Sigils, in the Drawing Room, long rows of slanted desks under skylights.

memory.fact: Nala's Wednesday: Sigils at ten in the Drawing Room, and the afternoon free.

event: Ink pots, steel nibs, thick cream paper; the sigils tutor, a small brisk woman, teaches in ink.

memory.fact: Sigils are taught in the Drawing Room, a long room of slanted desks under skylights, in ink.

event: Group F sits among two other groups; you take the desk beside Lin, who looks quietly pleased.

memory.fact: Sigils are taught in the Drawing Room, a long room of slanted desks under skylights, in ink.

event: Kit takes the desk in front of you, back straight, and keeps her eyes on her paper.

memory.fact: Sigils are taught in the Drawing Room, a long room of slanted desks under skylights, in ink.

event: Your first nib blots; your second scratches through the paper; Lin slides you a softer nib.
She shows you how to hold the pen loose, and load less ink; her fingers move yours once.

memory.fact: Lin gave Nala a softer nib, and showed her how to hold the pen loose and load less ink.

event: On paper, slow, with nobody watching, your glim sigil comes out clean: stroke, loop, hook in.

memory.fact: Nala drew a clean glim sigil in ink in her first Sigils class, and the tutor said good.

event: The tutor walks the rows and stops at Lin's desk; she holds Lin's page up for the whole room.
"This," she says, "is a sigil." Lin goes scarlet to the ears and stares at her inkwell.

memory.fact: In Sigils the tutor held Lin's page of glims up to the whole Drawing Room: "This is a sigil."
In Sigils the tutor held Lin's page of glims up to the whole Drawing Room: "This is a sigil."

event: After, you tell Lin under your breath that the tutor's right; Lin hides her smile in her sleeve.
Leaving the Drawing Room, Kit falls into step beside you in the corridor, eyes ahead.
"Whatever you think you saw last night," she says, low and clipped.
You say you saw the best glims in the year, and that it's hers, and you've told nobody.

memory.fact: Nala told Kit she saw the best glims in the year, Kit's, and has told no one and will not.
Nala keeps what she saw of Kit through the Practice Hall window to herself, telling no one.

event: Kit stops walking; she looks at you properly for the first time since the dinner.
"Thank you," she says, stiffly, as if the word costs her.
"Stop thanking me," you say; Kit's mouth twitches, and then she laughs, once, surprised.

memory.fact: Kit thanked Nala stiffly, and laughed once, surprised, when Nala told her to stop thanking her.

event: She walks off fast, ears pink; you stand in the corridor grinning at the stone floor.
Lunch, quick; Bea announces the afternoon is free by old custom and everyone walks to the village.

memory.fact: By old custom Wednesday afternoons are free at Hollowmere, and most students walk to the village.

event: Bea collects you, and you collect Lin from the floor below; Lin says yes before Bea finishes.

memory.fact: By old custom Wednesday afternoons are free at Hollowmere, and most students walk to the village.

event: The shore path is a mile of shingle and bracken, the fells bright, the wind cold off the mere.
Shiv catches you up halfway, parka open, hair damp, and walks with you as if invited.
Hollowmere village: one slate-roofed street along the shore, a pub, a shop, a tearoom by a jetty.

memory.fact: Hollowmere village is one slate-roofed street along the shore, a mile from the academy.
Hollowmere village is one slate-roofed street along the shore, a mile from the academy.
Hollowmere village is one slate-roofed street along the shore, a mile from the academy.

event: The pub is the Drowned Bell, low-beamed; Shiv says the jukebox is older than any of you.

memory.fact: The village pub is the Drowned Bell, low-beamed, with a fire and a jukebox older than the students.
The village pub is the Drowned Bell, low-beamed, with a fire and a jukebox older than the students.
Shiv plays the Drowned Bell jukebox's one Pogues record every night.
Shiv plays the Drowned Bell jukebox's one Pogues record every night.
Shiv plays the Drowned Bell jukebox's one Pogues record every night.
Shiv swims in the mere every dawn, forbidden or not, and has since arriving a week early.
Shiv swims in the mere every dawn, forbidden or not, and has since arriving a week early.
Shiv swims in the mere every dawn, forbidden or not, and has since arriving a week early.

event: The shop sells bread, stamps, cheap charms, ink and paper; Lin buys a bottle of black ink.

memory.fact: The village shop sells bread, milk, stamps, postcards, charms in paper packets, ink and paper.
The village shop sells bread, milk, stamps, postcards, charms in paper packets, ink and paper.
The village shop sells bread, milk, stamps, postcards, charms in paper packets, ink and paper.

event: In the charity shop Bea dresses you like a doll: an old fisherman's jumper, a wool hat.

memory.fact: The village charity shop sells second-hand black gowns, old jumpers and books.
The village charity shop sells second-hand black gowns, old jumpers and books.
The village charity shop sells second-hand black gowns, old jumpers and books.

event: Lin finds a battered book of sigils from the fifties and holds it like treasure.

memory.fact: Lin bought black ink at the village shop, and a 1953 book of sigils at the charity shop.
Lin bought black ink at the village shop, and a 1953 book of sigils at the charity shop.
Lin bought black ink at the village shop, and a 1953 book of sigils at the charity shop.

event: Bea pays for your jumper and waves it off: you can buy the scones next week.

memory.fact: Bea bought Nala an old fisherman's jumper at the charity shop, and Nala owes her scones for it.

event: Kit stops walking and turns to you, and looks at you straight on, in daylight, for a long moment.
You split one with Bea, cream and jam; Shiv eats two; Lin eats half of hers very slowly.

memory.fact: The tearoom by the village jetty does warm scones the size of fists, with cream and jam.
The tearoom by the village jetty does warm scones the size of fists, with cream and jam.
The tearoom by the village jetty does warm scones the size of fists, with cream and jam.
The tearoom by the village jetty does warm scones the size of fists, with cream and jam.

event: Amara sweeps past your table with second-years, touches your shoulder, says, "Freckles."

memory.fact: Amara touched Nala's shoulder in the village tearoom in passing, and called her Freckles.
Amara touched Nala's shoulder in the village tearoom in passing, and called her Freckles.
Amara touched Nala's shoulder in the village tearoom in passing, and called her Freckles.
Amara touched Nala's shoulder in the village tearoom in passing, and called her Freckles.

event: You go red; Shiv laughs so hard she has to put her head on the table.
Walking back at dusk, Shiv takes you out onto the slab of rock where she swims every dawn.

memory.fact: Shiv goes into the mere off a flat slab of rock near Thornfield, where it is deep straight off.
Shiv goes into the mere off a flat slab of rock near Thornfield, where it is deep straight off.
Shiv goes into the mere off a flat slab of rock near Thornfield, where it is deep straight off.

event: She dares you to put your feet in; you do; the cold is so total you shriek and she cackles.

memory.fact: Shiv dared Nala to put her feet in the mere off her rock; Nala did, and shrieked at the cold.
Shiv dared Nala to put her feet in the mere off her rock; Nala did, and shrieked at the cold.
Shiv dared Nala to put her feet in the mere off her rock; Nala did, and shrieked at the cold.

event: "Come in with me some morning," Shiv says, easy; you say maybe, and mean it more than you expected.

memory.fact: Shiv asked Nala to swim in the mere with her some morning, and Nala said maybe.

event: Bea links her arm through yours on the last stretch, your new jumper scratchy and warm.
Evening, the Thornfield kitchen: Lin comes up with her new ink and the old sigil book.
You practise the glim with Lin beside you, curling the hook in, slow, the way she drew it.
The spark comes, and this time it lifts an inch off your palm and lasts two heartbeats.

memory.fact: On Wednesday evening Nala's glim spark rose an inch off her palm and lasted two heartbeats.
On Wednesday evening Nala's glim spark rose an inch off her palm and lasted two heartbeats.

event: Lin makes a small pleased sound; you grab her inky hand without thinking, and she lets you.
She takes her hand back gently after a moment, pink, and says goodnight.

memory.fact: Nala took Lin's hand when her glim rose; Lin let her, then took it back gently, pink.

event: Alone in room 14 you take out the empty phone and type Alan's old number from memory.
You stare at it a long time, thumb over the button, then delete it, unsent.

memory.fact: Nala typed Alan's old number into the empty phone, then deleted it unsent.

event: Your head aches from the practice; you go down the corridor and knock on room 1.
Yusra opens the door in a soft jumper, reading glasses on, a healing textbook open behind her.

memory.fact: Yusra means to be a licensed healer, and spends her nights in the infirmary or the library.

event: Her room is neat as a ward: books squared, a kettle, a small bowl of lemons by the window.

memory.fact: Yusra wears reading glasses at night, and keeps her room neat as a hospital ward.

event: She sits you on her desk chair, and takes your wrist to feel your pulse, a healer's habit.
She tells you it's a lighter headache than yesterday's; you're overreaching less already.
She gives you water and two paracetamol, and asks how the day was, and actually listens.

memory.fact: Yusra took Nala's pulse, gave her paracetamol for a lighter headache, and heard about her day.

event: You tell her about the scones and the jumper and the rock; you leave Kit out.

memory.fact: Bea bought Nala an old fisherman's jumper at the charity shop, and Nala owes her scones for it.
Amara touched Nala's shoulder in the village tearoom in passing, and called her Freckles.
Shiv dared Nala to put her feet in the mere off her rock; Nala did, and shrieked at the cold.
Shiv goes into the mere off a flat slab of rock near Thornfield, where it is deep straight off.

event: She says Doyle will have you swimming in the mere by term's end, and she'll pretend not to know.

memory.fact: Yusra knows Shiv swims off the rock, and will pretend not to know if Nala swims too.

event: At the door her hand rests on your shoulder a moment: "Sleep, Ashby." You do, almost at once.
A day at Hollowmere ends.
